desc:
Build your tycoon by picking between 3 jobs with your friends or make new friends along the way! Play as a builder, fighter, or worker and buy cars for your garage, trees for your plot, or weapons to protect your base and raid other bases. Increase your income and become the richest! And have fun with your mates! If you had so, upvoting the game helps a lot :) note: this is not the first 3-player tycoon, I couldn't find any 3-player tycoons when I made this game and gave it this name.)
